title: vsdiff Review Session v1
description: An agent-authored guided review over a live git diff. Diff content is never embedded: hunk ids resolve against whatever diff `source` names, computed fresh on load. Unknown fields are preserved everywhere (additionalProperties is deliberately true at every level); `x-` prefixed keys are reserved for agent experiments. Three rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced by `vsdiff validate` instead: chapter/stop/support ids must be unique (stop ids across the whole session), a hunk id may appear at most once in the entire document, and an anchor's `end` must not precede its `start`.

title.description: Short human title for the change under review.

focus.description: One or two sentences naming what the reviewer should watch.

intent.description: "proposal" marks the stops as draft review comments awaiting triage.

chapters.description: Conceptual groups in display order, ordered by review leverage rather than file order. May be empty.

support.description: Changed hunks deliberately kept off the main path. Hunks referenced by nothing are auto-collected into a synthetic "uncovered" group on load.

hunkId.description: `<path>:h<n>` — the n-th hunk of that file's patch in the diff `source` names, counted from 1. The LAST `:h<digits>` suffix is the separator, so `a:h2b.ts:h1` is hunk 1 of the file `a:h2b.ts`.

sessionSource.description: Which diff every hunk id in this session resolves against.

base.description: Old-side ref or SHA, e.g. "main". Required for a "range" source.

head.description: New-side ref or SHA, e.g. "HEAD". Required for "commit" and "range" sources.

guideRef.description: Optional agent-authored HTML guide rendered in a webview panel.

html.description: Path relative to the session directory, e.g. "guide/index.html".

commitProposal.description: Commit message proposed for a working-tree session; surfaced as an "Apply commit message" action.

pullRequestRef.description: Pins a GitHub-sourced session to the head it was authored against.

title.description: Names the idea the chapter groups — never a file path.

priority.description: How a skimmer should treat this chapter's stops. Unset means "must". "nice" is internal-facing, easily reversible, low blast radius — an FYI, not a gate — and the blurb must say why in one line.

stops.description: The review path for this chapter, one review idea per stop.

stop.description: One review idea. Must point at changed code (hunkIds), a line range (anchors), or both.

id.description: Unique across the WHOLE session; feedback events and deep links address stops by id.

severity.description: Ranks findings only — valid solely when kind is "finding".

priority.description: Overrides the chapter's priority for this stop; unset inherits it, and an unset chapter is "must". "nice" is internal-facing, easily reversible, low blast radius — an FYI, not a gate — and the prose must say why in one line.

title.description: Semantic 2-6 word title — never a file path.

prose.description: Inline markdown; no headings, lists, or other block structure.

allOf.$comment: severity is meaningful only on a finding
a stop must land the reviewer somewhere

anchor.description: A line range in a file — the only way to point at UNCHANGED code.

side.description: Which side of the diff the line numbers belong to.

context.description: Snippet from the anchored lines; relocates the anchor when the file drifts.

reason.description: Why it is off the main path, e.g. "generated", "lockfile", "mechanical rename".
